resources.string: A new pin. A controlled test.
Simulate a fixed GPS location on your own device. No root, accounts, maps, or network access.
Enter decimal degrees. North / east are positive; south / west are negative.

1. Enable Developer options: tap Build number seven times in Android Settings → About phone.\n2. In Developer options, choose Select mock location app → FlipPin.\n3. Turn on the device Location setting, then start spoofing here. Allow location permission when prompted.

Use only on devices and applications you are authorized to test. Android marks these fixes as mock locations; apps may detect or ignore them. This does not change your IP address, cellular location, or bypass anti-spoofing checks. Some fused-location apps and OEM devices may not use these providers.
